source.title: NLR HPC Facility Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) Data
source.credit: DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE; dataset published by National Laboratory of the Rockies

method.samplingAssumption: Reported power is treated as point samples. Publisher does not specify sensor averaging or aggregation windows.
method.powerToEnergy: Piecewise-linear power interpolation and trapezoidal integration; only valid intervals <=90 seconds. No extrapolation; excluded time remains uncovered.
method.periodPUE: Integrated five-component facility energy / integrated IT energy over identical valid intervals. Never the arithmetic mean of sample PUE.
method.weather: Most recent same-facility source-clock observation at or before power time, maximum age 90 seconds. Clock alignment is unverified.
method.heatReuse: energy_reuse and ere are preserved only as raw fields. Their units/definitions are insufficiently documented for derived heat-recovery claims.
method.scene: Authored room and equipment geometry. Facility totals are not disaggregated into invented rack measurements.
